woodcraft.name: Woodland hands
woodcraft.desc: Learn to collect fallen branches and harvest wood. The beginning of something bigger.

shelter.name: A place of our own
shelter.desc: Turn branches and woven leaves into a safe, dry place to sleep.
shelter.unlocks: Build a leaf shelter · Build a learning circle

stonework.name: Stone sense
stonework.desc: Spot useful stones and carefully work them free of the hillside.

firekeeping.name: A little spark
firekeeping.desc: Build and tend a cozy campfire. Warm paws, brighter evenings.

gardening.name: Green paws
gardening.desc: Grow a renewable patch of berries. A little planning makes tomorrow gentler.
gardening.unlocks: Build a berry garden · Build a grain patch · Gather wild grain

woodwork.name: Grain & patience
woodwork.desc: Shape two pieces of wood into a plank at a workbench.

cooking.name: Something delicious
cooking.desc: Cook two berries, one water and one wild meat into two hearty meals at a campfire.

tracking.name: Reading the wild
tracking.desc: Follow trails into the meadow and return with provisions. Hunting is shown as a gentle, off-screen expedition.

commerce.name: Hello, neighbor
commerce.desc: Build a place to meet travelers. Buy necessities with an allowance and fill neighborhood requests.
commerce.unlocks: Build a market · Buy supplies · Deliveries

masonry.name: Well made
masonry.desc: Build a well for fresh water close to home. Less walking, more living.

architecture.name: Dream a little bigger
architecture.desc: Build a proper cottage from planks and stone. A warm new chapter for two old friends.

invention.name: Bright little ideas
invention.desc: Build a study nook. Curious afternoon experiments earn shared research points.
invention.unlocks: Build a study nook · Research autonomously

fiberwork.name: A thread to follow
fiberwork.unlocks: Twist rope at a workbench · More useful structures
fiberwork.desc: Turn loose plant fibers into a dependable length of rope.

claywork.name: Earth between our paws
claywork.desc: Recognize the soft clay deposits beside the spring.

weaving.name: Something soft, something strong
weaving.desc: A little thread becomes a blanket, an awning or a greenhouse shade.

pottery.name: A shape that stays
pottery.unlocks: Build a kiln · Fire bricks and pots
pottery.desc: Clay becomes something lasting with a careful amount of heat.

herbalism.name: The helpful little leaves
herbalism.unlocks: Gather herbs · Build an herbarium · Make soothing balm
herbalism.desc: Recognize helpful plants and prepare a comforting balm.

joinery.name: Stronger at the seams
joinery.unlocks: Make timber beams · Build a workshop
joinery.desc: Join planks and cordage into a frame that can carry bigger dreams.

metalwork.name: A patient kind of fire
metalwork.unlocks: Gather ore · Build a smelter · Smelt iron · Make tools
metalwork.desc: Transform ore and charcoal into iron, then put it to useful work.

horticulture.name: A greener tomorrow
horticulture.unlocks: Build a greenhouse · Improve garden yields
horticulture.desc: Combine a dependable water supply and a protected growing space.

milling.name: When the wind helps
milling.unlocks: Build a windmill · Mill grain into flour
milling.desc: The glade grows grain. A turning sail makes it useful.

baking.name: The smell of coming home
baking.unlocks: Build a bakery · Bake nourishing bread
baking.desc: Mix flour and water, then let a good oven do its part.

logistics.name: A place for every possibility
logistics.unlocks: Build a storehouse · Nearby crafting works faster
logistics.desc: An orderly storehouse saves steps around the workshops.

mentorship.name: Learning how to learn
mentorship.unlocks: Improve the learning circle · Better coached practice
mentorship.desc: Patient teaching and a comfortable place make new ideas stick.

engineering.name: A little world in motion
engineering.unlocks: Build a waterwheel · Upgrade advanced workshops
engineering.desc: Let a turning wheel do some of the work. Nearby stations benefit.

glassmaking.name: A window into wonder
glassmaking.unlocks: Fuse mineral stone into glass at the kiln · Observatory parts
glassmaking.desc: A game-world recipe: mineral-rich stone and charcoal become clear glass.

stewardship.name: Roots for the future
stewardship.unlocks: Build an orchard · Improve food-growing places
stewardship.desc: Plant a generous orchard and build for a home that can sustain itself.

scholarship.name: A sky full of questions
scholarship.unlocks: Build an observatory · More shared research
scholarship.desc: Put observation, good instruments and careful records together.

shelter.name: Leaf shelter
shelter.desc: A safe little nest. Better sleep and comfort.

bench.name: Workbench
bench.desc: A place to turn resources into possibilities.
bench.effect: Make planks, rope and timber beams with the matching learned skills.

fire.name: Campfire
fire.desc: Warm paws. Stories. A light to come home to.
fire.effect: A warming place, a cooking station and a way to make charcoal.

garden.name: Berry garden
garden.desc: A little care today. A little food tomorrow.

market.name: Market stall
market.desc: Open your clearing to a world of neighbors.
market.effect: Pip can shop. You can trade and delegate deliveries.

well.name: Stone well
well.desc: Bring fresh water closer to home.
well.effect: Water gathering is faster and close to home.

cottage.name: Woodland cottage
cottage.desc: From a little clearing to a proper home.
cottage.effect: The best sleep. A permanent comfort bonus.

study.name: Study nook
study.desc: A quiet corner for bright little ideas.
study.effect: Pip can independently earn shared research.

circle.name: Learning circle
circle.effect: Lessons are 12% faster. Coached practice gains +1 mastery point.
circle.desc: A ring of cushions, an open notebook, and permission to get it wrong.

grainplot.name: Grain patch
grainplot.effect: Grows grain; Pip can harvest it when a recipe or reserve needs it.
grainplot.desc: A small patch of golden stalks. Tomorrow starts here.

loom.name: Weaving loom
loom.effect: Turns fibers and rope into cloth.
loom.desc: Soft comforts and sturdy cloth begin with a patient shuttle.

kiln.name: Clay kiln
kiln.effect: Fires bricks and pots; later, fuses glass.
kiln.desc: An earthy little oven for making things that last.

herbarium.name: Herbarium
herbarium.effect: Turns herbs, water and a pot into soothing balm.
herbarium.desc: Hang a few leaves. Label a few jars. Care can be crafted.

workshop.name: Timber workshop
workshop.effect: Makes tools. Nearby construction within 3 tiles is 10% faster.
workshop.desc: A sheltered place for the ambitious, slightly crooked first attempt.

smelter.name: Little smelter
smelter.effect: Smelts ore and charcoal into iron.
smelter.desc: A contained, careful fire for big new possibilities.

mill.name: Windmill
mill.effect: Mills grain into flour. Its sails turn while the world runs.
mill.desc: The breeze lends a hand. Pip still decides when to make flour.

bakery.name: Glade bakery
bakery.effect: Bakes fresh bread. One loaf restores 40 food.
bakery.desc: A warm doorway and something good cooling on the sill.

greenhouse.name: Growing house
greenhouse.effect: A productive herb bed. Garden and grain-patch regrowth is 20% faster.
greenhouse.desc: A woven shade-house before the glade learns to make glass.

storehouse.name: Storehouse
storehouse.effect: Crafting stations within 4 tiles work 12% faster.
storehouse.desc: Every useful thing has a place; every trip can be a little shorter.

waterwheel.name: Waterwheel
waterwheel.effect: Must be near the spring. Stations within 4 tiles work 18% faster.
waterwheel.desc: Quiet power from the spring, shared with nearby workshops.

orchard.name: Bramble orchard
orchard.effect: Grows berries generously. A peaceful place adds +8 joy to play.
orchard.desc: A promise of shade, fruit and many unhurried afternoons.

observatory.name: Stargazer’s nook
observatory.effect: Autonomous research yields +2 shared points. Lessons are 10% faster.
observatory.desc: A little lens, a wide sky, and someone to share the question with.

woodland.name: Woodland ways
woodland.description: Read the land. Bring home what it offers.

making.name: Timber & thread
making.description: From a fallen branch to a carefully joined frame.

homestead.name: A living home
homestead.description: Food, warmth, gardens and a place to belong.

craft.name: Earth & fire
craft.description: Clay, charcoal, metal and bright little inventions.

community.name: Life together
community.description: Useful places, generous work and shared independence.

discovery.name: Curious minds
discovery.description: Practice, observation and the next good question.

together.name: Side by side
together.desc: A patient lesson: +3 starting practice and +3 friendship.

playful.name: Learn through play
playful.desc: A gentler pace: +14 joy, +2 friendship and less mental effort.

independent.name: Room to try
independent.desc: 20% faster lessons; +1 starting practice, with more mental effort.

balanced.name: Steady paws
balanced.desc: Standard work time. A dependable finish.

careful.name: Made with care
careful.desc: 35% more work time; +18 finish quality; +1 practice per stage.

quick.name: Simple & useful
quick.desc: 22% less work time; −12 finish quality. Still fully usable.

woodland.name: Gentle forager
woodland.desc: +1 item per natural harvest, limited by the node’s remaining stock.

woodland.name: Field observer
woodland.desc: Exploration is 20% faster and earns +1 shared research.

making.name: Patient craftspaw
making.desc: Timber and thread recipes work 15% faster.

making.name: Thoughtful builder
making.desc: Completed buildings and upgrades gain +12 finish quality.

homestead.name: Generous cook
homestead.desc: Every completed food recipe yields one extra meal or loaf.

craft.name: Fine finisher
craft.desc: Completed buildings and upgrades gain +10 finish quality.

community.name: Neighborly trader
community.desc: Shared income from sales and deliveries increases 15%.

community.name: Prepared provider
community.desc: Crafting and gathering for pantry reserves is 20% faster.

discovery.name: Patient mentor
discovery.desc: Lessons work 15% faster; coached practice earns +2 mastery.

discovery.name: Bright spark
discovery.desc: Autonomous experiments and completed field studies earn +1 research.

branches.name: From branch to belonging
branches.desc: Notice what changes when raw materials become part of a home.

threads.name: The strength of small things
threads.desc: Test how fibers can become useful structure.

earth.name: What the fire changes
earth.desc: Compare the earth before and after a careful firing.

harvest.name: Tomorrow in a seed
harvest.desc: Follow the grain from the patch to a shared table.

neighbors.name: Better, together
neighbors.desc: Learn from useful work that reaches beyond our clearing.

stars.name: A question worth keeping
stars.desc: Connect practice, experiments and a place to watch the sky.

home.name: A warm first home
home.desc: The gentle first loop: learn, gather, build, care.

threads.name: Timber, thread & tools
threads.desc: A making path from loose fibers to a real workshop.

earth.name: Earth into possibility
earth.desc: A chain of clay, charcoal, bricks, ore and iron.

harvest.name: From garden to table
harvest.desc: Grow grain, mill flour, bake bread, plant for tomorrow.

wonder.name: A life of little discoveries
wonder.desc: A place for learning and a window onto the stars.

CONTRACTS.name: A neighbor’s new fence
CONTRACTS.desc: Rowan needs a few straight planks.

CONTRACTS.name: A basket for the road
CONTRACTS.desc: Travelers are packing for a long walk.

CONTRACTS.name: A hearth before winter
CONTRACTS.desc: Help Fern stock up for a cozy evening.

CONTRACTS.name: Supper for the village
CONTRACTS.desc: Two warm meals would make someone’s day.
